synopsis.text:
The evil Warlock wants to take over the world! He calls his fellow monsters to join him, but several refuse - and after casting a shrinking spell that backfires and shrinks down all the monsters around him, transporting them to different homes in Los Angeles.

Warlock didn't let his size impairment get in the way of world domination, however, so it's up to The Vampire and The Monster to stop him! Along the way, both characters will have to fight through Warlock's henchmonsters through the streets, sewers, a construction area and even a Japanese garden.

The game features classic platforming action. The player only has one all-purpose attack and they can also double jump to avoid enemies or reach high ledges. The player can also pick up small objects and use them to attack several enemies at once. If there's only one player, they can choose between The Vampire or The Monster. Or if they don't want to go alone, a friend can join in and help them beat Warlock in the two player co-op mode.

The game is based on the Monster In My Pocket toy franchise. The package also included a limited edition Monster in My Pocket toy, Blemmyea (#81), which was only available with this game.

Basé sur la ligne de jouets du meme nom, Monster in My Pocket suit les aventures  d'un vampire miniature et du monstre de Frankenstein alors qu'ils se battent contre d'autres créatures folkloriques et mythologiques de la même taille.

Der böse Hexenmeister will die Welt erobern! Er ruft seine Gefolgsmonster auf, sich ihm anzuschließen. Aber einige weigern sich - und nachdem er einen Schrumpfungszauber gewirkt hat, der nach hinten losgeht und alle Monster um ihn herum schrumpfen lässt - bringt er sie in verschiedene Häuser in Los Angeles. Doch Warlock lässt sich nicht von seiner Größenbeschränkung davon abhalten, die Weltherrschaft an sich zu reißen, und so liegt es nun an "The Vampire" und "The Monster", ihn aufzuhalten! Auf ihrem Weg müssen sich die beiden Charaktere durch die Straßen, die Kanalisation, eine Baustelle und sogar einen japanischen Garten kämpfen, um sich gegen Warlocks Handlanger durchzusetzen.

Basado en la línea de juguetes del mismo nombre, Monster in My Pocket sigue las aventuras de un vampiro en miniatura y el monstruo de Frankenstein mientras luchan contra otras criaturas populares y mitológicas del mismo tamaño.

Basato sull'omonima linea di giocattoli, Monster in My Pocket segue le avventure di un vampiro in miniatura e del mostro di Frankenstein mentre combattono contro altre creature popolari e mitologiche della stessa taglia.

O malvado Warlock quer dominar o mundo! Ele chama seus companheiros monstros para se juntarem a ele, mas vários recusam - e depois de lançar um feitiço de encolhimento que sai pela culatra e encolhe todos os monstros ao seu redor, transportando-os para diferentes casas em Los Angeles.

Warlock não permitiu que sua diminuição de tamanho atrapalhasse a dominação mundial, então cabe ao Vampiro e ao Monstro pará-lo! Ao longo do caminho, os dois personagens terão que lutar contra os capangas de Warlock pelas ruas, esgotos, uma área de construção e até mesmo um jardim japonês.
